characters.name: Aconit
characters.visual_description: Predominantly botanical monkshood flower-woman with a lightly humanized cool-blue face nested inside a tall cobalt aconite hood, narrow expressive indigo eyes, petal planes instead of human hair, sharp leaf-and-vine limbs and no visible human skin texture

signature_details: single silver crescent marking beneath the left eye
two small blue aconite blossoms growing from the right shoulder vine
wants: keep the greenhouse and Belladone alive
identify the sender of the forbidden inheritance
fears: being understood too clearly by Belladone
characters.voice_description: Low precise French mezzo voice, restrained breath, dry timing and warmth carefully hidden under authority

characters.name: Belladone
characters.visual_description: Predominantly botanical flower-woman with a lightly humanized lavender face emerging from a broad deep-plum belladonna corolla, large expressive violet eyes, petal curls instead of human hair, leaf-and-vine limbs and no visible human skin texture
characters.wardrobe: Her silhouette is formed entirely by layered plum petals, dark olive sepals and flexible climbing vines, with no ordinary fabric clothing, shoes or human accessories
signature_details: tiny black heart marking under the right eye
cluster of exactly three glossy black belladonna berries at the left hip
purple heart-shaped nectar gem at the throat
wants: transform every danger into a game
make Aconit admit that she cares
discover why the forbidden inheritance chose them
fears: being treated like a fragile ornamental flower
revealing sincere attachment before Aconit does

characters.name: La Graine Noire
characters.visual_description: A glossy black botanical seed shaped like a small anatomical heart, split by one thin violet seam, with tiny rootlets like veins and no human face, limbs or readable species

wants: force Belladone and Aconit to reveal what binds them
characters.voice_description: Tiny sexless French whisper doubled by a low subterranean resonance, intimate and unnervingly amused
